notes.text: 1) Reinaud يجر واحد — 2) Perperam apud Reinaud بينا, quod corrigere vult بيّنّن (sic). — 3) Cod.

observations: L03, L04, L07, L08, L09, L12, L13, L14, L20, L21: long joins (البحـور, فانّـه, تطلـع, فيُمْـكن, مــن, حســب, بلــد, مــا, وذِكْـرَ, المعلومــة, فعــل, يحتــاج) are not transcribed.
L04: والأفراق: a hamza alone (2.9 x 3.2 pt) over the lām-alif, one dot over the fā', the pair over the final qāf (1600 dpi).

L05: يُجْرِهِ: a damma over the yā', a sukun over the jīm (its dot stands below the ligature with the yā'), a kasra under the rā' and another under the hā' (1600 dpi); note 1 gives Reinaud's يجر واحد.
L05: وراءَ: the hamza and a fatha over it are one sort (3.6 x 5.0 pt), as the hamza and fathatan of جزءًا; the bare hamzas of الجزء, الاستواء, وشتاء and باجزاء measure 2.9 x 3.2-3.6 pt.
L05: يُنْكِره: the damma printed in two pieces (its tail a speck of 0.7 x 0.7 pt); over the nūn a small sukun (1.8 pt) stands above the nūn's dot; a kasra under the kāf (1600 dpi).
L05, L11: فانه (L05) and فانهم (L11) have no shadda; فانّه (L04) and فانّهم (L16) have it.
L07: in على the foot of the lām did not print: the stem stands free over the bowl of the yā', with a small fragment between them (1800 dpi; compare على on L06).
L10: رُسِمَ: a damma over the rā', a kasra under the sīn and a fatha (4.0 x 2.5 pt) over the final mīm (1600 dpi).

L12: «الجز ائرالعامرة» as printed: the word space stands inside الجزائر (3.1 pt after the zāy, against 1.3 pt in الجزائر on L18) and is missing before العامرة (0.8 pt; the other word spaces of the line measure 3.8-4.3 pt).
L12: «ارقيانس» as printed: the second letter is a rā' (a plain hook 3.9 pt above and 2.8 pt below the baseline, without the head of a wāw; 2400 dpi); p. 26 and p. 27 have اوقيانس.

L13: فعلِموا: a kasra (3.6 x 2.2 pt) under the lām (1400 dpi); فعلموا on L17 has none. بتقدُّم: shadda and damma in one mark (3.6 x 6.8 pt). خاصّةً: a shadda over the ṣād and a fathatan over the tā' marbūṭa.
L15: البلديْن: the yā' printed without its dots; the sukun over it and the dot of the nūn are clear (1400 dpi).

L15: ممَّنْ: a shadda with a separate fatha over it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a sukun over the nūn. يسلُك: the damma touches the top of the lām. الطُّرُق: shadda and damma in one mark (3.2 x 6.5 pt), a damma over the rā'.
L17: سمت is set with the sīn raised over the mīm, its teeth a short wavy stroke (as in الشمس and والشمال).
L17: بيّنّا: a shadda over the yā' and another over the nūn (3.2 x 2.2 pt each), the reading which note 2 defends.
L18: in بُعْدها the alif stands free, 0.9 pt from the hā': its join did not print (2400 dpi; compare بُعْدها on L16).
L19: أثْبَتْنا: a hamza alone (2.9 x 2.9 pt) over the alif, a sukun over the thā' (above its three dots) and another over the tā', a fatha over the bā' (1600 dpi).

L20: وذِكْرَ: a kasra under the dhāl, a sukun over the kāf and a fatha over the rā'; ذكرًا after it has only the fathatan. مُفْرَدًا: a damma, a sukun beside the dot of the fā', a fatha and a fathatan (1600 dpi).
L22: يستأنف: of the alif only its top printed (a tick 0.7 x 1.8 pt under the hamza; 2400 dpi).
N01: the Arabic of notes 1 and 2 (3000 dpi): يجر (yā' and jīm in ligature, the jīm's dot under the yā''s pair) واحد; بينا; بيّنّن with a shadda over the yā' and another over the first nūn.
